restoration_note: The teaching enumerates eight dwellings of the Living Fire (= divine love at eight registers). The repeating ordinal formula 'ⲦⲦⲙⲁϩ-N ⲙ̄ⲙⲁ ⲉⲧⲥⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧϥ̄ ⲡⲉ X' constrains most ordinal/locative gaps tightly, and parallels in section 4459 ('ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲥ ⲣⲁⲣ ⲡⲉ ⲧϣⲁⲣⲡ') and 4464 stabilize subject-copula restorations. Editor proposals are accepted for the structural-ordinal series (gaps 0-19, 24-30, 39, 43-46) and for the wreath/woman of the new land (gap 33-34). The most damaged stretch is 36-38 (line 4468), where only fragmentary traces survive and proposals are tentative; gaps 23, 38, 40 are too weakly constrained and are marked unrestorable. The fifth-fire formula ('the fire inside the water') and the eighth-fire 'signs of war' clause are restored using direct cosmological parallels and the standard Manichaean prognostic vocabulary.
